text: grep -n 'sub rsp' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fgets.rs | head -5; sed -n '425,450p' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fgets.rs: aved handle and line metadata emitter.instruction("sub rsp, 96"); // reserve the read-loop temporaries plus the bound and destination slots // Resolution is a call, so it has to happen inside the frame; an invalid stream // therefore leaves through the framed epilogue rather than a bare `ret`. emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 8], rdi"); // preserve the opaque stream handle emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 64], rsi"); // preserve the caller's length bound emitter.instruction("call __rt_stream_fd"); // resolve the backend descriptor through StreamState emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 56], rax"); // preserve the resolved backend descriptor // -- does the stream carry a read-filter chain? -- // See the AArch64 counterpart: probed once, because the answer picks the byte source for // every iteration of the loop and re-resolving the state per byte would cost a call.
